stories.title: Ohio State, Oregon start 1-2 in AP preseason poll
stories.summary: Ohio State and Oregon were 1-2 in the AP Top 25, giving the Big Ten Conference the top two teams in the preseason rankings for the first time in 65 years.

stories.title: New Heisman platform gives first vote to fans
stories.summary: The new team at Heisman has launched Heisman Hopefuls -- a data, storytelling and fan voting platform aimed at expanding the conversation about the award.

stories.title: Vikings lose Adams for season due to knee injury
stories.summary: Veteran defender Jamal Adams will miss the 2026 season because of a right knee injury he suffered Saturday in the Minnesota Vikings' 13-10 preseason victory over the New York Giants, the NFL Network reported Sunday.

stories.title: Texas native Miller agrees to deal with Cowboys
stories.summary: Veteran OLB Von Miller has agreed to terms with the Dallas Cowboys -- a source telling ESPN that it's a one-year deal.

stories.title: Sources: Cardinals RB Love has high ankle sprain
stories.summary: Rookie running back Jeremiyah Love, who played 23 snaps Thursday against the Las Vegas Raiders, is dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unlikely to play the rest of the preseason for the Arizona Cardinals, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Sunday.
